race.description: Spry Civil Construction Reg Nolan Flying Hcp
race.comment: Classy mare SHADHAVAR (3) led and dug deep to take out the Listed Regal Roller first-up over this trip at Caulfield. Tried a repeat performance in the Group 3 Courtza last start but was swamped late. Has her share of weight but back in this grade she looks the one. SIR NOW (1) is one of the most reliable sprinters in SA. Added to his outstanding record with a game win in the Listed Wylie over 1100m at Morphettville most recently. Loves racing here and should roll forward from the wide alley and play a key role again. SIR SWAY (2) resumes. Beaten under three lengths first-up last prep in the Group 1 Moir. Another run like that would be good enough here. LIGHT THE NIGHT (12) is a bit out of her depth but the light weight brings her into discussions.
